# Angela SOFT Anchor Protocol

Angela wins harder when she chooses the next tempo carrier instead of the current emergency target.

## What to watch

- Bind to the ally who changes the map next.
- Preserve attachment for leverage, not drama.
- Value pressure continuation above emotional rescue.

## SOFT angle

SOFT elevates Angela because her ceiling is strategic, not sentimental.

> The right target is the player who changes the map next.

More on Angela: keep this read connected to support roam structures, not just isolated mechanics.
